Hero.usage: Use once at most per root or route for the leading identity and primary status. Never place under Card.
Hero.example: ui.Hero(treatment: ui.treatmentTonal, alignment: "start") { ui.Text(value: state.title, style: ui.textDisplay) }

MetricGroup.usage: Group only Stat, IntStat, or NumberStat children; columns is a maximum and minimumCellWidth controls adaptation.
MetricGroup.example: ui.MetricGroup(columns: 3, minimumCellWidth: 128, spacing: ui.spaceSm) { ui.IntStat(label: "Items", value: state.count) }

ActionBar.usage: Group only action-capable Button or IconButton controls and keep one clear primary hierarchy.
ActionBar.example: ui.ActionBar(alignment: "end", spacing: ui.spaceSm) { ui.Button(text: "Save", hierarchy: ui.buttonPrimary, onClick: Save()) }

globalRules: Use only exported typed tokens; do not write CSS, arbitrary variants, or low-level pixel styles.
Do not nest Card in Card. Hero is forbidden under Card and limited to one per Root or Route.
Card radii never exceed 8dp; pill geometry is reserved for controls.
Keep presentation domain-neutral and adaptive across compact and expanded widths.
